Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 1771 (commit 77d46d98439, Change-Id I7996314ac61587198e3e3b6aedf75dd69699fd23), rebased on origin/main 7c946bdf898.

Detection: fsck_tracker_health.py check 4.10 — dirty_tracker_classes() classifies git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all into TRACKER_DIRTY_DELETION / TRACKER_DIRTY_LEFTOVER / TRACKER_DIRTY_TMP_EVENT (classes 1+2 counted issues; class 3 informational — a live .tmp-event-* belongs to an in-flight append). Fence: a stray *.retired preserved neither at HEAD nor on the sync remote is NOT classified (could be the only copy of an event). fsck.py JSON registration carries per-class count + paths + detail.

Repair: doctor.py --repair, TWO lock windows (write_lock is non-reentrant; run_repair holds no outer lock). Backup ref refs/rebar-doctor/<utc-ts> recorded at tickets HEAD BEFORE the first mutation (no backup ref => all mutating findings unrepairable). Window 1: one scoped write_lock — deletions restored via git checkout HEAD --, leftovers MOVED into <git-common-dir>/reconverge-quarantine/<utc-ts>/ via sync._quarantine_untracked (shared implementation, no drift). Window 2 (lock released): sync.reconverge self-locks and converges the store. Class 3 marked manual, byte-identical after run.

TDD: tests/unit/test_doctor_dirty_tree.py (11 tests) written first; RED proof 9/11 failed on unmodified src (ImportError dirty_tracker_classes, AttributeError doctor._quarantine_leftovers etc.; 2 vacuous negatives). Includes seeded-wedge end-to-end (all 3 classes + diverged origin), idempotence on clean store (zero changes, no backup ref), lock discipline probe (lock HELD during checkout/quarantine, NOT held entering reconverge), class-3-only store (no backup ref, no reconverge), unclassified-.retired fence.

Mutation pass: 9/9 manual mutants KILLED — skip backup ref, delete instead of quarantine-move, hold lock into reconverge, invert class routing, skip fsck JSON registration, _retired_source_folded forced False and forced True, drop --untracked-files=all, drop staged-deletion (D ) porcelain state, class-3 counted as issue.

Gates: make lint clean (complexity ratchet active=53 new=0 increased=0), make typecheck clean (538 files), LOC caps ok (doctor.py 503, fsck_tracker_health.py 384, fsck.py 325). Adjacent suites green (test_doctor.py, reconverge, union-recovery, fsck 270 passed). Full unit sweep: only pre-existing environmental failures (push/network + gh-vendor matrix + test_ref_lock remote roundtrip), all reproduced identically on unmodified src. docs/user-guide.md gained a section on the three findings and the doctor heal. Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified on change 1771.
